scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome to the
Kafra Corporation.
The Kafra services
are always on your side.
How may I assist you?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
歡迎光臨卡普拉公司！
卡普拉服務永遠在您身邊。
您需要什麼服務呢？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^666666W-weeeelc-c-come
to th-the K-kaaafrrrra
C-coorpoor-r-ratioooonn...^000000

[Kafra Employee]
Welcome. ^ff0000{0}^000000 Member.
The Kafra Coporation will stay with you wherever you go.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
歡迎光臨，^ff0000{0}^000000的成員。
無論您去往何處，卡普拉公司都與您同在。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
So, have you come from a faraway land to study our culture, or are you just sightseeing?
In either case, why not stay awhile?
The air is eternally heavy with the
scent of pleasant wildflowers.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
您是遠道而來了解我們的文化，還是來觀光的呢？
無論如何，不妨多待一會兒。
這裡的空氣總是瀰漫著怡人的野花香。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
With our many Kafra
service locations, you're never
far from home.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
卡普拉服務網點遍佈各地，讓您無論走到哪裡，都有賓至如歸的感覺。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Because of the ^FF0000Limited
Transport Agreement^000000, the
Kafra Corporation cannot
provide Teleport Services
in the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
受^FF0000有限運輸協議^000000限制，卡普拉公司無法在修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國提供傳送服務。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
We ask that you please
use the Airship Service
instead. Thank you for your
understanding and cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
請您改用飛空艇服務。
感謝您的理解與配合。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry but another guild member is using the guild storage
right now.  Please wait until that person is finished.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
很抱歉，另一位公會成員正在使用公會倉庫。
請等待該成員使用完畢。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^666666S-s-ssoooorry,
y-you're a-a-aaaa
Nooviiice... N-neeeds
B-basic sssskill l-level 6...^000000

[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you
need the Novice's
Basic Skill Level 6 to
use the Storage Service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
很抱歉，初心者的基本技能需要達到6級，才能使用倉庫服務。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^666666Zeeeeeny...
M-more z-zeny...!
N-neeed 150... zeny...
Ergh! T-taking bl-blood~!^000000

[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough zeny to use
the Storage Service. Our
Storage access fee is {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，無法使用倉庫服務。
使用倉庫需要{0} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^666666Thank you.. for... using...^000000
[Kafra Employee]
scripts.translation: [卡普拉 職員]

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Here, let me open
your Storage for you.
Thank you for using
the Kafra Service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
這就為您開啟倉庫。
感謝您使用卡普拉服務。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Please choose
your destination.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
請選擇您的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you don't have
enough zeny for the Teleport
Service. The fee to teleport
to {0} is {1} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，無法使用瞬間移動服務。
前往{0}的費用是{1} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but the
Pushcart rental service
is only available to Merchant classes.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
很抱歉，手推車租賃服務僅對商人系職業開放。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but the
Pushcart rental service
is only available to Merchants,
Blacksmiths, Master Smiths,
Alchemists and Biochemists.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
很抱歉，手推車租賃服務僅對商人、鐵匠、神工匠、鍊金術士和生物化學家開放。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You already have
a Pushcart equipped.
Unfortunately, we can't
rent more than one to
each customer at a time.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
您已經裝備了一輛手推車。
很遺憾，我們一次只能租給每位顧客一輛。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You can only rent a cart after learning the "Push Cart" skill.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
必須先學會“手推車使用”技能，才能租用手推車。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Pushcart rental
fee is {0} zeny. Would
you like to rent a Pushcart?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
手推車租賃費是{0} Zeny。
您想要租用手推車嗎？

scripts.text: Rent a Pushcart.
scripts.translation: 租用手推車

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
zeny to pay the Pushcart
rental fee of {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，
無法支付{0} Zeny的手推車租賃費。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Let's see...
{0}...
Ah, you have a total of
{1} Special Reserve Points.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
讓我看看...
{0}...
啊，您共有{1}點特殊儲備點數。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You can exchange your
Special Reserve Points for
rewards at the Kafra Main Office in Al De Baran. Please use our
convenient services to see the benefits of our rewards program.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
您可以前往艾爾帕蘭的卡普拉總部，用特殊儲備點數兌換獎勵。
多使用我們便捷的服務，就能享受獎勵計劃帶來的優惠。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Your Respawn Point
has been saved here
{0}.
Thank you for using
the Kafra Services.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
您的復活點已保存於{0}。
感謝您使用卡普拉服務。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
We, here at Kafra Corporation,
are always endeavoring to provide you with the best services. We hope that we meet your adventuring needs and standards of excellence.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
卡普拉公司始終致力於提供最優質的服務，希望能滿足您的冒險需求，不負您的期待。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^666666Kaffffra n-never
diiiiiiiiiiiiiies. On...
On y-yooour siiiiide~^000000

[Kafra Employee]
Saved.
Thank you for your patronage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
已儲存。
感謝您的惠顧。
